levels.title: Module 7 Level 1
levels.solution: SELECT name, capacity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY capacity DESC) AS capacity_rank FROM venues;
levels.hintMessage: Use RANK() OVER with ORDER BY capacity DESC.

levels.title: Module 7 Level 2
levels.task: Assign row numbers to performances by set_time.
levels.solution: SELECT artist_name, set_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY set_time) AS row_num FROM festival_performances;

levels.title: Module 7 Level 3
levels.task: Show running count of performances by set_time.
levels.solution: SELECT artist_name, set_time, COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY set_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count FROM festival_performances;
levels.hintMessage: Use COUNT() OVER with an ordered frame.

levels.title: Module 7 Level 4
levels.task: Show each performer and the total number of performances.
levels.solution: SELECT artist_name, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_performances FROM festival_performances;
levels.hintMessage: COUNT(*) OVER () repeats the grand total.

levels.title: Module 7 Level 5
levels.task: Show venues and compare each capacity to the previous one.
levels.solution: SELECT name, capacity, LAG(capacity) OVER (ORDER BY capacity DESC) AS previous_capacity FROM venues;
levels.hintMessage: Use LAG with ORDER BY capacity DESC.
